messages:
maria (oncall): :rotating_light: alert: unusual spike in KMS Decrypt ops from service account ci-runner-01, started ~10:42 UTC. 3500 decrypts in 5m. see logs below
IncidentBot: Alert generated by kms-monitoring:decrypt_spike severity=high src=ci-runner-01 key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/data/keys/artifact-key
Jules - SecOps: @maria can you confirm if any deploys or CI runs were expected at that time?
maria (oncall): nothing scheduled in CI, no prod deploys. checked pipelines, only a few queued jobs.
Rohit - EngInfra: pulling audit logs now. give me a minute.
Leah - SRE: quick containment suggestion: restrict ci-runner-01 SA key access policy, and blacklist the key for new decrypts until we know scope. Can we do a temporary deny?
Rohit - EngInfra: Found repeated decrypt entries from 35.204.12.9 -> runs show pattern: start, decrypt, upload artifact. Example log line:
```
{"timestamp":"2026-03-20T10:42:15Z","principal":"serviceAccount:ci-runner-01@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com","method":"cryptoKeyVersions:accessAsymmetricDecrypt","key":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/data/cryptoKeys/artifact-key/cryptoKeyVersions/1"}
```
Priya - Compliance: Ensure we preserve immutable audit trail. Do NOT delete logs; export to long-term storage if needed.
Samir - EngOncall: I'm starting a log export to gs://redwood-incident-logs/decrypt-spike/1881234567 . keeping retention, snapshotting current key state.
Jules - SecOps: Good. Also run a principal scope check: list bindings for that SA and recent impersonations. Could be token exfil.
Rohit - EngInfra: Running: `gcloud iam service-accounts get-iam-policy ci-runner-01@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"ci-runner-01@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"" --limit 50`
Rohit - EngInfra: Policy shows the SA has access to artifact-key via binding to role/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on key ring. No recent role grants in last 30d.
Leah - SRE: Temporary mitigation: add a conditional binding to prevent decrypt until we verify. If provider doesn't allow conditional, rotate key material and revoke key versions.
Priya - Compliance: If we rotate, ensure KMS key rotation is documented and that HSM/KMS audit entry exists for rotation. We need an incidence tag for compliance review.
maria (oncall): Action list: 1) Restrict SA: done? (Rohit) 2) Export logs (Samir) 3) Snapshot key version and rotate if needed (Leah) 4) Notify CISO (Jules) 5) Handoff to next oncall in 2h (Samir).
Rohit - EngInfra: I applied a deny binding for decrypt on artifact-key to ci-runner-01. Verified `accessDenied` responses for new calls. Old tokens might still succeed until revoked.
Samir - EngOncall: Export started, files writing. tagging export with incident=decrypt-spike-1881234567.
Leah - SRE: Snapshot created of cryptoKeyVersion/1, blocked new access. Recommend rotating to version/2 and disabling v1. Command I used:
```
gcloud kms keys versions disable 1 --key=artifact-key --keyring=data --location=global --project=redwood
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=artifact-key --keyring=data --location=global --project=redwood
```
Jules - SecOps: Notifying CISO and exec for potential data exposure. Preparing comms: internal only for now.
Priya - Compliance: Please preserve key metadata and key policy snapshots. I'll attach them to the case.
maria (oncall): Any indication of exfil of plaintext?
Rohit - EngInfra: No uploads to external buckets seen. The decrypts correlate with internal artifact pushes to gs://redwood-artifacts-prod/ci/.. We need to audit artifact contents.
Samir - EngOncall: Starting integrity check of artifacts created between 10:30-10:50 UTC. Will checksum compare with previous builds.
Leah - SRE: If artifacts are suspicious, quarantine the bucket prefix and revoke object access.
Jules - SecOps: Good. Opening incident ticket INC-2026-1881234567. tagging teams: eng-infra, sre, compliance, legal.
Priya - Compliance: Legal looped in. Also request: preserve all related KMS audit logs for 90 days and flag for forensic review.
maria (oncall): Current status: decrypts blocked for SA, logs exported, snapshot & rotate started, artifact integrity checks running. No confirmed exfil.
Samir - EngOncall: Artifact checks 0/18 mismatches so far, still scanning.
Rohit - EngInfra: Checking if CI runner was compromised: reviewing recent docker images and tokens used. Found an automated token exchange at 10:41 from ephemeral-runner@github-actions. Investigating further.
Jules - SecOps: If we see token exchange, rotate any tokens, revoke sessions, and add as part of remediation.
Priya - Compliance: Add timeline notes for audit: actions taken, who performed them, and exact commands. We'll need these for post-incident review.
maria (oncall): Outline for handoff in 2h: include current mitigations, links to exported logs, key snapshot, artifact checks, and outstanding tasks (forensic artifact analysis + token rotation). Assign next lead @Samir.
Samir - EngOncall: taking handoff. I'll run full forensic artifact analysis and continue token rotation. I'll update the ticket with progress.
Jules - SecOps: Thanks team. Postmortem owner: @Priya to coordinate compliance/legal + tech write-up. We'll run a blameless postmortem after containment.
maria (oncall): Closing war-room for now, monitoring-only. Handoff to @Samir at 12:45 UTC. If anything changes, re-open this thread. :white_check_mark:
